air:Brand.Name: ECONOMY BASIC
air:Brand.air:Title: Economy Basic
YBASIC
air:Brand.air:Text: A smart choice for travellers who don’t require checked baggage.

Etihad’s Economy cabins are designed for comfort, convenience and calm. Settle into ergonomic seats with generous recline and cosy blankets, switch on with hours of on-demand entertainment, and indulge in delicious complimentary food and drinks. On longer flights, surf or stream with onboard Wi-Fi or stay up to date with live TV and news.
• Cabin baggage: 7kg • No checked baggage • Change not permitted • Refund not permitted • Earn 15% Etihad Guest Miles
* Refer to fare rules for full terms and conditions * Products and services may vary between aircraft and on flights operated by other airlines

air:Brand.air:Title: Economy Flex Plus
EcoFlxPlus
air:Brand.air:Text: Upgrade to Economy Flex Plus to enjoy the full flexibility to make changes to your booking, enjoy more baggage allowance, choose your seats for free, and earn more Skywards Miles.

Economy Flex Plus includes:
• Free seat selection and paid seat selection • Earn 1 Skywards Mile for every mile flown • Checked baggage allowance • Cabin baggage 1 bag up to 7kg • Regional multicourse dining • Complimentary alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks • Up to 5,000 channels of entertainment • Free unlimited online chat messaging for Emirates Skywards Gold members • Buy great value Wi-Fi plans • Eligible to upgrade with Skywards Miles • Changes permitted free of charge • Fully refundable
